ratio_policy: All ratios are recomputed from the displayed source values. They can differ in the last digit from ratios reported from unrounded measurements.
benchmark_provenance: The initial K1 + K2 kernel, GSM8K and AgentX measurements used these kernels while hosted in ROCm/aiter#6196. The source reports import/helper/formatting changes when moving the code into vLLM and reproduces selected numerical checks.
All FFN-launch measurements and TP4 GSM8K used the in-tree vLLM implementation.
The kernel, GSM8K and AgentX measurements predate per-width scratch isolation. The source reports unchanged kernel time after the fix across 24 TP2/TP4 points: mean ratio 1.000, range 0.996-1.009.
The pinned reviewed revision is not presented as the exact revision used for every benchmark. No new GPU benchmarks were run for this article.

serving_protocol.speculation: DSpark; five draft tokens; synthetic acceptance length 3.51 including target token
serving_protocol.interactivity_definition: 1 / P90 per-request inter-token latency in seconds
serving_protocol.throughput_definition: Request input + output token count divided by duration; includes cached input. Not generated-output throughput and not normalized per GPU.
serving_protocol.off_on_baseline: TP2, same node and protocol; four concurrency settings run concurrently on one eight-GPU node. K1 + K2 on 30 layers only.
serving_protocol.coverage_baseline: FlyDSL K1 + K2 on 30 layers versus adding the FlyDSL FFN launch on the other 10. TP2 is the rerun reported by the source after node-wide stalls in an earlier round.
serving_protocol.coverage_itl_ratio: Median of matched requests inter-token latency: 40-layer / 30-layer configuration.
serving_protocol.limits: No repeated-run confidence intervals. Synthetic acceptance bypasses natural rejection sampling. TTFT reported only for the TP2 off/on table; no TTFT values are supplied for the coverage table.

layer_protocol.baseline: vLLM modules for the same layer or FFN path, in a TP process group
layer_protocol.scope: Microseconds per layer; not full-model or serving latency.
